scope: Phase 3.10 optional capture experiment; sync remains default

hardware_comparison.condition: real camera and MediaPipe, full 1080p CPU VIDEO, headless, no gestures/controls, every measured detection count zero; one pair, not CPU-isolated

excluded_prototypes_from_primary_compari.camera_only_latest_initial_timeout: 5s startup expired before normal 5.94s MSMF configuration; safely released. Final startup budget 15s.
excluded_prototypes_from_primary_compari.real_headless_latest_initial_warmup: Warmup included camera configuration time. Retained as exploratory only; repeated with full model warmup.
excluded_prototypes_from_primary_compari.all_hardware_reports: Some were captured before final counter-field normalization/log wording and join deadline metadata additions; steady-state acquisition/inference path is unchanged.

data.limitations:
Synthetic blocking-call overlap experiment, NOT webcam or MediaPipe FPS.

The producer sleeps for a chosen read delay; the consumer sleeps for a chosen
processing delay. Sleeps release the GIL. This isolates handoff/overlap and copy
cost; it does not model sensor timing, CPU contention or recognition accuracy.
